other_conditions: Selection of beneficiary villages is done by a District Committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner with members including district heads and the local MLA
Works are to be carried out by villagers who are willing to work and are above 18 years of age
Funds are released in three phases, each amounting to 33.33% of the total allocation, based on submission of utilization certificates
Implementation is overseen by the Block Development Office jointly with the Gram Panchayat
Construction of pucca houses is limited to BPL families who are not already beneficiaries of PMAY/IAY schemes
benefits_summary: The scheme provides comprehensive infrastructure development in villages, including piped water, electricity or solar lights, pucca houses for BPL families, community toilets, irrigation canals, schools, health centers, drainage, internal roads, and market‑shed facilities.
application_link: Please contact to the Gram Panchayat office as well as Block Development Office.
